technical.name: Price vs 50-day MA
technical.description: Current price relative to the 50-day simple moving average, as a percent.
technical.rubric: 0-10 scale centered on trend strength: <-15% -> 0-1 (strong downtrend), -15% to -5% -> 2-3 (downtrend), -5% to +2% -> 4-6 (neutral/consolidating, 5 at 0%), +2% to +10% -> 7-8 (uptrend), >+10% -> 9-10 (strong uptrend). Score scales linearly within each band.

technical.name: Price vs 200-day MA
technical.description: Current price relative to the 200-day simple moving average, as a percent.
technical.rubric: Same shape as the 50-day rubric but reflects the longer-term trend: <-20% -> 0-1, -20% to -5% -> 2-3, -5% to +5% -> 4-6 (5 at 0%), +5% to +20% -> 7-8, >+20% -> 9-10.

technical.name: RSI (14-day)
technical.rubric: RSI < 30 -> 8-10 (oversold, potential opportunity, lower RSI = higher score), RSI 30-45 -> 6-7, RSI 45-55 -> 5 (neutral), RSI 55-70 -> 3-4, RSI > 70 -> 0-2 (overbought, higher RSI = lower score).

technical.name: Relative performance vs S&P 500 (3-month)
technical.description: Stock's total return over the trailing 3 months minus the S&P 500's total return over the same period.
technical.rubric: Underperform by >15% -> 0-1, underperform 5-15% -> 2-4, within +/-5% -> 5-6, outperform 5-15% -> 7-8, outperform >15% -> 9-10.

technical.name: Volatility / Beta
technical.rubric: This parameter scores stability, not opportunity: beta 0.8-1.2 -> 7-8 (moderate, stable), beta 1.2-1.6 or 0.5-0.8 -> 5-6, beta >1.6 or <0.5 -> 3-4 (higher risk/uncertainty either direction). Used as a risk-context parameter, not a bullish/bearish signal.

fundamental.name: P/E ratio vs sector average
fundamental.description: Trailing P/E ratio compared to the stock's sector/industry average P/E.
fundamental.rubric: P/E > 50% above sector avg -> 0-2 (expensive), 20-50% above -> 3-4, within +/-20% -> 5-7 (fairly valued), 20-40% below -> 8-9, >40% below sector avg (and profitable) -> 10. If P/E is negative/not meaningful, mark null and note why.

fundamental.name: Revenue growth (YoY, most recent quarter or TTM)
fundamental.description: Most recently reported year-over-year revenue growth rate.

fundamental.name: Earnings growth (YoY)
fundamental.description: Most recently reported year-over-year EPS or net income growth rate.
fundamental.rubric: Negative/declining -> 0-2, 0-8% -> 3-4, 8-15% -> 5-6, 15-30% -> 7-8, >30% -> 9-10. If earnings are negative both periods (still unprofitable), mark null and note why.

fundamental.name: Debt-to-equity ratio
fundamental.description: Most recently reported total debt-to-equity ratio.
fundamental.rubric: D/E > 2.0 -> 0-2 (high leverage), 1.0-2.0 -> 3-5, 0.4-1.0 -> 6-7, <0.4 -> 8-10 (low leverage). Context-adjust only if the framework notes a capital-intensive sector norm; otherwise apply as-is.

sentiment.name: Analyst consensus rating
sentiment.description: Current Wall Street analyst consensus rating and approximate number of analysts covering.
sentiment.rubric: Consensus Sell/Underperform -> 0-2, Hold -> 4-5, Moderate Buy -> 6-7, Buy -> 8-9, Strong Buy (broad coverage, high conviction) -> 10.

sentiment.name: Recent analyst rating changes (last 30 days)
sentiment.description: Net direction of analyst rating/price-target changes in the last 30 days.
sentiment.rubric: Multiple downgrades/net negative revisions -> 0-2, mixed/no significant activity -> 4-6, net upgrades or price-target raises -> 7-8, multiple upgrades/strong positive revisions -> 9-10.

sentiment.name: Recent news sentiment (last 30 days)
sentiment.description: Overall tone of major news coverage in the last 30 days (product launches, litigation, management changes, macro exposure, etc.).
sentiment.rubric: Predominantly negative (scandal, guidance cuts, litigation risk) -> 0-2, mixed/neutral -> 4-6, predominantly positive (strong product/business news) -> 7-8, major positive catalyst dominating coverage -> 9-10.

sentiment.name: Short interest (% of float)
sentiment.description: Most recently reported short interest as a percent of float.
sentiment.rubric: This parameter scores bearish positioning: >10% of float -> 0-2 (heavy bearish bets), 5-10% -> 3-5, 2-5% -> 6-7, <2% -> 8-10 (low bearish positioning).

sentiment.name: Insider buying/selling activity (last 90 days)
sentiment.description: Net direction of insider (Form 4) transactions in the last 90 days.
sentiment.rubric: Significant net insider selling (multiple execs) -> 0-3, routine/mixed activity or no notable transactions -> 4-6, notable net insider buying -> 7-10.

no_action_rule: If any single category has 2 or more null/unresolvable parameters for a stock, or an entire category's output is missing for that stock, the decision is NO ACTION regardless of computed score.
notes: SPCX (SpaceX) is privately held / not a traditional publicly-traded equity as of this framework's creation; Agents 2-4 should verify current tradability status and flag heavily-null categories accordingly rather than fabricating market data.
Weights and thresholds are configurable here without touching any agent's logic.
All research agents must cite a source (URL/provider + access date, or filing reference) per parameter value; null values must include a one-line reason.
